run.change_description:
refactor: resolve SonarQube findings

- Reduce cognitive complexity in runProviderBackups, displayStartupConfig,
  checkProvider, Run and checkProvidersDefined by extracting focused
  helpers; behaviour and log output unchanged.
- Extract duplicated backup status titles into constants with a shared
  backupStatusTitle helper (notify.go).
- Remove TestPublicGitLabRepositoryBackup2 (identical duplicate of
  TestPublicGitLabRepositoryBackup) and simplify
  TestGiteaOrgsRepositoryBackup with assertion helpers.
- Dockerfile: merge consecutive RUN instructions, sort apk packages,
  quote the TAG variable in the download URL.

summary.intent: Resolve 13 SonarQube findings by extracting helpers, constants and Dockerfile tidying, with behaviour and log output unchanged (pr-195-text, commit-136a485).
summary.issue_fit: Unavailable as an issue; no originating issue exists. The supplied PR text and commit message are the intent source, and every ledger row is met or not-verifiable.
summary.coverage: Complete merge-base diff of all 4 files reviewed. `go build ./...` and `go vet ./internal/` were clean, and `go test ./internal/ -count=1` passed once at the head (live provider tests skip without credentials). The Dockerfile was not built (no Docker) and was judged by trace. No candidate survived falsification, so no verification batch was needed. Prior Copilot comments (double `resetBackups()`, 'Organistations' typo) both predate this change and were dropped.

observations.fact: `checkProvidersDefined` now computes the Bitbucket API-token state before the map loop, so OAuth counting no longer depends on random map iteration order.
observations.evidence: `internal/backup.go:680-717` at head versus `internal/backup.go:625-672` at the merge-base.
